messages:
eval-bot: nightly-eval failed: v3.2 rollout (weights + tokenizer) // financial-structured-output promptset fail rate 3.8% -> 18.2% (run at 03:12 UTC)

sara: who approved v3.2 canary? seeing a lot of malformed tables and truncated totals in nightly.

kevin: that was my PR merge (models#412). weight refactor changed layernorm ordering; tokenizer had punctuation normalization tweaks. didn't expect structured-output fallout.

maria: dropping a couple representative fails from the eval run: 

maria: EXPECTED:
```
Invoice:
- item: "Server time"
- amount: 120.00
Total: 120.00
```

maria: ACTUAL:
```
Invoice:
- item: "Server"
- amount: 120.00
Total: 1
```

maria: also saw JSON keys missing and CSV rows stopping mid-line.

jonah: could be tokenizer merging hyphens/numbers differently, or a decoding early-stop from kv misalignment. any tokenizer merge diffs?

kevin: tokenizer diff is small (hyphen/en-dash normalization). main change was the layernorm reorder.

ana: note: int4 canary was turned on for v3.2 in the dedicated canary pool (quant.enabled=true, mode=int4-lowmem). quant could amplify issues.

sara: we need to isolate weight vs tokenizer vs quant. can someone run ablation matrix? old/new combos and quant on/off.

devops-bot: canary deployment created: canary/v3.2-quant (pool: canary-int4-1) at 04:00 UTC

kevin: starting runs: (A) old-weights+old-tokenizer, (B) new-weights+old-tokenizer, (C) old-weights+new-tokenizer, (D) new-weights+new-tokenizer. logging to /tmp/v3_2_triage.

maria: sliced failing set down to 42 cases (financial-structured-output). uploaded to eval console: https://console.redwood/evals/triage/3625001234

maria: quick observations: (B) still shows numeric truncations with no quant -> weights likely contributing. (C) shows merged hyphen tokens but totals intact.

maria: (B) sample:
```
- item: "Server time"
- amount: 120.00
Total: 1
```

maria: (C) sample:
```
- item: "Server-time"
- amount: 120.00
Total: 120.00
```

jonah: sounds like two separate failure modes: weight change -> premature stop/truncation, tokenizer change -> token merging and formatting shifts.

ana: ran (D) with int4: failures worsen, extra hallucinated fields and more truncation. quant amplifies but isn't the sole root cause.

jonah: I added runtime debug to emit token ids and kv cache offsets for failing cases. collecting for 10 samples.

kevin: doing weight ablation: revert layernorm-order locally (pre-refactor commit b3d2 vs refactor c7a9f). will report in ~45m.

maria: token diffs from eval harness show: pre: ["Server", " time"] post: ["Server-", "time"] which explains hyphen behavior.

kevin: ablation findings: reverting layernorm order reduces numeric truncation by ~80% on the 42-case set. weight change is main cause for truncation.

ana: per-layer quant toggles show layer 13 int4 causes instability when combined with new layernorm ordering.

jonah: kv-offset logs reveal occasional off-by-one in prefix length after layernorm reorder, leading decoder to stop early on the total token.

sara: mapping so far: weight refactor -> kv/prefix alignment bug -> numeric truncation. tokenizer normalization -> token merge changes -> formatting oddities. quant int4 amplifies both.

sara: immediate mitigation: block canary expansion, roll back quant canary, prepare a hotfix reverting the layernorm reorder and add runtime guard.

devops-bot: canary/v3.2-quant removed at 04:45 UTC

kevin: creating hotfix branch v3.2.1 and PR (models#418). adding unit test for numeric totals and structured-output smoke.

jonah: pushing kv-alignment guard (runtime assert) to detect off-by-one prefixes before decode proceeds. will gate on assert in canary.

ana: keeping int4 disabled until guard and hotfix are in. will schedule focused quant stress runs once guard is live.

maria: re-run of the 42-case set after hotfix applied locally: failure rate dropped to 4.2% (close to baseline). artifacts uploaded to the triage run.

sara: good. follow-ups: add structured-output smoke to rollout preflight (must match token-boundary histogram within threshold), require token-histogram delta < 2% for canary > 10%.

jonah: adding smoke to rollout pipeline and histogram check.

kevin: merging hotfix after CI; will coordinate controlled canary redeploy with runtime guard.

maria: documenting incident and eval artifacts: https://docs.redwood/triage/3625001234

sara: thanks all. keep posting deploy/eval status here and ping if customer comms needed.

devops-bot: deploy queued: models:v3.2.1 -> canary (1 node) at 06:30 UTC
